name: Air compressor
description: An upright tank compressor with the motor on top. Runs air tools and fills tyres. Needs power.
notes: A placed workshop machine rather than a carried item; the size is only a placeholder.

name: Arc furnace
description: A small electric furnace for melting steel. Three carbon electrodes reach down through the roof. Draws a great deal of power.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x14.8): the reference volume is 400 L, which no working arc furnace fits in, but its 2 m longest side and 1024 kg mass are kept. I modelled the furnace at full size. This is furniture, not an item; the size is only a placeholder.

name: Arcade cabinet
description: An upright coin-op video game cabinet. The screen, wiring and power supply can be stripped for parts.
notes: This is furniture; the size is only a placeholder. Its box is 3.5 times the reference volume because the cabinet is mostly hollow.

name: Band saw
description: A floor-standing band saw on a closed base. Cuts wood and soft metal in curves. Needs power.
notes: A placed workshop machine. The reference gives a longest side of 2.16 m, and the model stands 2.05 m tall. Its box is 2.5 times the reference volume because the table and housings leave open space.

name: Battery charging box
description: A wooden box holding a mains battery charger and two clip leads. Charges batteries left in it.
notes: Modelled with the lid open, so the box is 1.8 times the reference volume.

name: Radioisotope generator
description: A sealed, lead-shielded power source with cooling fins. It gives a small, steady current for years.
notes: I renamed the id: the reference id reads as a jargon acronym. At 100 kg this is a carried or vehicle-mounted part, not something for a backpack. The core uses the lead finish and the shell steel-grey.

name: Drill press
description: A floor drill press on a cast base. Drills straight holes in wood and metal. Needs power.
notes: A placed workshop machine. Its box is 2.8 times the reference volume because the column leaves open space.

name: Charging foot locker
description: A steel foot locker with a charging panel built into the front. Charges the batteries stored in it.
notes: I renamed the id to read as a noun. The body is olive-painted steel.

name: Glass furnace
description: An electric crucible furnace on legs, lined with fired clay. Melts glass for blowing. Needs power.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x5.6): the 0.4 m legs and the side control box leave most of the bounding box empty. The drum alone is about 106 L against the reference 62.5 L, which I accepted to keep the 1 m height.

name: High-pressure compressor
description: A breathing-air compressor in a carry frame. Fills scuba and firefighter air bottles. Needs power.
notes: I renamed the id so it reads plainly. It is two-person portable at 52.5 kg.

name: Hydraulic press
description: A shop press with a bottle jack in a steel H-frame. Presses bearings and bends metal.
notes: A placed workshop machine. It is hand-pumped, so it needs no power.

name: Jointer
description: A long woodworking machine that planes board edges straight and flat. Needs power.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x4.6): the 2.2 m cast tables overhang a 0.8 m stand, so the bounding box is mostly empty. The longest side and mass match the reference.

name: Mitre saw
description: A sliding mitre saw on extension wings. Cuts boards to length at an angle. Needs power.
notes: The model is set up for cutting, with the wings out. It is a benchtop tool, so it carries its quality as a tool rather than as a workstation.

name: Electric oven
description: A free-standing electric oven with a glass door. Bakes and roasts. Needs power.
notes: The reference files this under tools. It works as a kitchen workstation once placed.

name: Oxygen concentrator
description: A home medical unit on casters that pulls oxygen from room air. Needs power.
notes: The plastic-white body stands in for an off-white medical plastic.
